<details>
<summary>klauspost/compress (github.com/klauspost/compress)</summary>

### [`v1.20.1`](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/releases/tag/v1.20.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.0...v1.20.1)

#### What's Changed

- zstd: apply reset options to reused frame decoders by [@​pellared](https://redirect.github.com/pellared) in [#​1226](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1226)
- flate: Report unexpected EOF for truncated Huffman extra bits by [@​rupayon123](https://redirect.github.com/rupayon123) in [#​1229](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1229)
- flate: avoid FMA in EstimatedBits for portable rounding by [@​malt3](https://redirect.github.com/malt3) in [#​1224](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1224)
- gzhttp: preserve caller request headers in Transport by [@​jakezwang](https://redirect.github.com/jakezwang) in [#​1225](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1225)
- gzhttp: only decompress a request when gzip is the outermost coding by [@​youdie006](https://redirect.github.com/youdie006) in [#​1223](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1223)
- zstd/huff0: Optimizations by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1203](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1203) [#​1205](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1205) [#​1207](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1207) [#​1204](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1204) [#​1208](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1208) [#​1211](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1211) [#​1209](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1209) [#​1210](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1210)
